result.stdout:
Description:
  Compare AOT build size against a baseline and enforce size budgets

Usage:
  dotsider size-check <target> [options]

Arguments:
  <target>  Native AOT binary or .mstat size report to check

Options:
  --baseline <baseline>          Baseline binary or .mstat to diff against
  --budget <budget>              Size budget (e.g. max=25mb or ns=System.Text.Json:growth=10kb); repeatable
  --budget-file <budget-file>    JSON file with budgets ({ "budgets": [spec or object, ...] })
  --top <top>                    Top contributors per section and per violated budget (default 10) [default: 10]
  --why                          Attach dependency chains for top added contributors (needs the target's DGML sidecar)
  --format <format>              Output format: text (default), json, or markdown
  --summary-file <summary-file>  Additionally write the markdown report to a file (e.g. "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY")
  -o, --output <output>          Write output to a file instead of stdout
  -?, -h, --help                 Show help and usage information
  --json                         Output results as JSON

result.stdout:
Description:
  Headless assembly analysis

Usage:
  dotsider analyze <file> [options]

Arguments:
  <file>  Assembly or native module to analyze (.dll, .exe, or .wasm)

Options:
  --types                              List type definitions
  --methods                            List method definitions
  --il <il>                            Disassemble a method (format: Type.Method)
  --embedded-source <embedded-source>  Print embedded source for a method (format: Type.Method)
  --deps                               Show assembly references and dependency graph
  --strings                            Extract strings from the assembly
  -n, --min-len <min-len>              Minimum length for raw string extraction (default: 4) [default: 4]
  --size                               Show size breakdown
  --symbols                            List native symbols (Native AOT and other native binaries)
  --disasm <disasm>                    Disassemble a native function (name or 0xVA)
  --why <why>                          Explain why a type or method is in a Native AOT binary (requires mstat and DGML sidecars)
  --correlate <correlate>              Correlate a Native AOT binary with its pre-ILC assembly. Bare: print correlation counts. With a value (Type.Method or 0xVA): print IL and native code side by side.
  --r2r-correlate <r2r-correlate>      Correlate a ReadyToRun image's managed methods with their precompiled native code. Bare: print precompiled-method stats. With a value (Type.Method, 0xTOKEN, or 0xVA): print IL and native code together.
  --fields                             List field definitions
  --bundle                             Show single-file bundle manifest
  -o, --output <output>                Write output to a file instead of stdout
  -?, -h, --help                       Show help and usage information
  --json                               Output results as JSON
